name: Authority-Separated Voice Braid
central_result: For portable user->AI->Frank interaction, holder authentication and delegated scope are insufficient to prove which semantic payload segments are original user intent. A parent-sealed provenance braid plus per-turn intent ceiling eliminated all modeled authority-laundering attacks in the synthetic proxy, but an ideal RFC8693+RAR+sender-constrained baseline tied that safety result.
design_refutation: Initial relay-self-signed grant design was refuted because a relay could widen its own incoming scope. Corrected proxy requires every incoming grant edge to be sealed by the parent/grantor; presenter proof is separate.
counterevidence: OAuth Token Exchange subject/actor semantics, Rich Authorization Requests, DPoP/resource restriction and attenuating credentials are established prior art. Under an ideal exact-claim assumption the standards baseline also has 0 false allow/deny. ASVB therefore has no support as a replacement authorization protocol.
surviving_scope: ClayCode semantic voice provenance above standard authentication/authorization: AUTHENTICATED_ORIGIN, RELAY_ACTOR, TRANSPORT_METADATA and RELAY_ASSERTED_ORIGIN remain distinct through DE_TO_CLAY, cognition, memory/reentry and effect gating.
product_law: If a user simply hands a bearer token to an AI, Frank can authenticate/authorize that token holder within token scope, but cannot infer that arbitrary text labeled 'the user said' is cryptographically authenticated user-origin speech without a separate origin binding.
next_test: Implement the smallest standards-based subject/actor + rich-authorization + sender-constrained envelope on the real Frank API path. Run direct user, user->AI->Frank, multi-relay and AI-only conversations through DE_TO_CLAY; measure whether plain application provenance preserves voice boundaries and effect authority as well as ASVB. Include token rotation/revocation, audience, replay, global-busy holder continuity and translator-summary attacks. If simple standard metadata ties ASVB with less complexity, record ASVB NO_BENEFIT.
